description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a semi-transparent band around it; the Vanilla curve is purple, StrmLLM (n=64) is light blue, SepLLM (n=64) is orange, SepLLM (n=64, H) is green, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is red, and SepLLM (n=128) is dark blue. All lines start near the top of the axis (around 3.4 at iteration 0), drop steeply within the first several thousand iterations to roughly the 2.7–2.9 range, and then decline more gradually through 140,000 iterations: the light-blue StrmLLM (n=64) line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.62 by 140,000; the purple Vanilla line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.46; the orange SepLLM (n=64) line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.52; the green SepLLM (n=64, H) line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.50; the red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.49; and the dark-blue SepLLM (n=128) line decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.51, with all curves showing smooth, monotonic downward trajectories after the initial sharp drop.
